|-- [M] RecordStorage owns the local record cache and serialized write queue
|   |-- Exposes get / keys / batch / store / remove / flush / commit / subscribe
|   |   `-- RecordTransport.write(WorkspaceBatch) -> Promise<{ revision }>
|   |       `-- Encoding and HTTP remain behind this transport interface
|   |
|   |-- [O] Private mutable state
|   |   |-- cache: Map<key, value> -> latest locally submitted records
|   |   |-- pending: Map<key, StorageChange> -> coalesced changes awaiting a batch
|   |   |-- flight?: { batch, sequence } -> retained until successful acknowledgement
|   |   `-- running / timer / revision / sequence / persisted / error / failures
|   |
|   |-- [C] batch(changes) is synchronous
|   |   |-- same(old, new) compares nested values -> unchanged records are skipped
|   |   |-- Apply cache changes; pending.set(key, change) replaces older queued values
|   |   `-- Changed submission -> sequence++; schedule(); notify()
|   |       `-- Default debounce 150 ms, bounded by 1 s since first pending change
|   |
|   |-- [C] pump() allows one running transport write
|   |   |-- Existing running Promise -> return it
|   |   |-- No flight -> capture pending into a WorkspaceBatch; clear pending
|   |   |   `-- [D] crypto.randomUUID() + revision + pending.values()
|   |   |       `-- { requestId, expectedRevision, changes }
|   |   `-- transport.write(flight.batch)
|   |       |-- Success -> revision = result.revision; persisted = flight.sequence
|   |       |   `-- Clear flight/error/failures; later pending changes can follow
|   |       `-- Failure -> retain flight; record error; increment failures
|   |           |-- Uncertain outcome -> retry the same batch and requestId
|   |           |-- Automatic retries use exponential delay capped at 30 s
|   |           `-- REJECTED:, VERSION_CONFLICT, REQUEST_ID_CONFLICT stop auto-scheduling
|   |
|   |-- [D] sequence > persisted -> status.pending; running exists -> status.writing
|   |   `-- [C] flush() captures target = sequence and pumps until persisted >= target
|   |       `-- Page subscribes to status for save feedback and errors
|   |
|   `-- [C] commit(changes) supports acknowledgement-before-install operations
|       |-- flush earlier work -> snapshot cache -> batch(changes) -> flush()
|       |-- REJECTED: -> restore previous cache; clear pending/flight; throw
|       |   `-- A definitively rejected UI operation cannot be published later by retry
|       `-- Other failures -> wait 500 ms and retry while storage remains open
|           `-- An interrupted response may follow a committed write

`-- [M] WorkspaceStorage bridges the workspace to one persistent worker
    |-- [O] records?: RecordStorage; worker?: Worker; requests: Map<id, waiter>
    |   |-- ensureWorker() lazily creates and reuses the worker
    |   |-- request(input) -> postMessage({ ...input, id, endpoint })
    |   |-- worker.onmessage -> delete waiter; resolve result or reject error
    |   `-- Worker error -> reject all waiters, terminate worker, clear worker handle
    |
    |-- [C] load() shares ready and constructs RecordStorage from loaded state
    |   `-- Worker readState() -> GET /api/mapping/workspace/records?history=current
    |       |-- [D] state.records -> recordsWorkspace() -> deserializeWorkspace(..., 'current')
    |       `-- known: Map<key, serialized record> is initialized from the response
    |
    |-- [C] RecordTransport.write(batch) -> request({ type: 'write', batch })
    |   `-- Worker normalizes records and POSTs /api/mapping/workspace/records
    |       |-- [O] bodies: Map<requestId, serialized body>
    |       |   `-- Retained body gives retries identical bytes within the worker lifetime
    |       |-- Success -> apply submitted changes to known; delete cached body
    |       |-- HTTP 4xx -> delete body; report 'REJECTED: ...'
    |       `-- Other HTTP failures -> 'Write uncertain: ...'; retain body
    |           `-- Transport failures also leave the body available for retry
    |
    |-- [C] Explicit workspace operations use the same RecordStorage queue
    |   |-- save(snapshot) -> load(); records.flush(); project(snapshot); records.commit()
    |   |   |-- [D] workspaceRecords(deserializeWorkspace(snapshot)) + worker.known
    |   |   |   `-- Changed/new records + deletions for absent keys
    |   |   `-- MappingWorkspacePage.publishTransfer() awaits save() before installWorkspace()
    |   `-- saveDocument(document, index, create) -> flush(); records.commit(...)
    |       |-- documentRecords(document) + 'workspace' index -> one submitted batch
    |       |-- create=true checks for existing document metadata
    |       `-- projectDiagrams() awaits acknowledgement before adding the child session
    |           `-- Existing sessions and editors are retained
    |

        |-- restore() -> flush old records; dispose them; clear ready; load again
        |-- visibilitychange to hidden -> viewState.flush(); storage.flush()
        |-- beforeunload checks pending view/storage state and dirty or busy drafts
        `-- dispose() -> records.dispose(); worker.terminate(); reject remaining waiters
            `-- RecordStorage.dispose() clears timer/listeners; callers must flush first
